name: Gluta White Night Cream | Advanced Brightening & Anti-Aging Formula with Glutathione & Vitamins (50ml)
description:
Wake up to visibly brighter and smoother skin with Gluta White Night Cream (50ml) — a premium nighttime formula enriched with Glutathione, Vitamin C, Niacinamide, and Hyaluronic Acid. Designed to deeply nourish, repair, and revitalize your skin while you sleep, it targets dark spots, dullness, fine lines, and uneven tone for a radiant morning glow. This antioxidant-rich blend promotes collagen production, restores hydration, and helps you achieve a soft, luminous, and youthful complexion.
Perfect for men and women of all skin types, this cream delivers lasting brightness, hydration, and anti-aging care — all in one luxurious nightly treatment.
Key Features:
 Brightens and evens out skin tone overnight
 Reduces dark spots, freckles, and pigmentation
 Fights wrinkles and smooths fine lines
 Deeply hydrates and nourishes with Hyaluronic Acid
 Enriched with Glutathione, Vitamin C & E for antioxidant protection
 Restores skin’s natural radiance and softness
 Suitable for all skin types – men and women
 Free from harmful chemicals and parabens
How to Use:
 Cleanse your face and pat dry
 Apply a small amount evenly on face and neck
 Gently massage in upward circular motions until absorbed
 Use nightly for best results
 Apply sunscreen in the morning if used overnight
Ingredients:
 Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (3%) – Brightens and protects
 Niacinamide (3%) – Evens skin tone and refines texture
 Kojic Acid Dipalmitate (1.5%) – Reduces pigmentation and spots
 Hyaluronic Acid (0.5%) – Deeply hydrates and plumps skin
 Alpha Arbutin (2%) – Fades dark spots and improves glow
 Vitamin E (1%) – Antioxidant protection and moisture boost
Package Includes:
 1 × Gluta White Night Cream Tube (50ml)
